title: AWS CloudOps Engineer
subtitle: Monitor, automate, deploy and keep AWS workloads secure and available
audience_line: System administrators and operations engineers running workloads on AWS
overview: This programme teaches participants to operate workloads on Amazon Web Services and prepares the AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate exam (SOA-C03). They monitor and tune workloads with CloudWatch, X-Ray and Compute Optimizer, automate remediation with EventBridge and Systems Manager, keep services available with Auto Scaling, load balancing, AWS Backup and disaster recovery strategies, deploy with CloudFormation and the AWS developer tools, run containers on ECS and EKS, enforce security and cost controls, and troubleshoot networks. Every chapter ends with a lab, exam practice closes the content, and the programme ends with a final project: a workload operated end to end by each team.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: System administrators and operations engineers running workloads on AWS

facts.label: Prerequisites
facts.value: AWS Cloud Practitioner (course), or equivalent hands-on use of the core AWS services; Linux command line. Core services are not introduced again

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: 33 h: 27 h of chapters + 6 h buffer

facts.label: Format
facts.value: Short lectures followed by guided labs; exam practice

facts.label: Lab environment
facts.value: One laptop per participant with the AWS CLI; one AWS sandbox account per team, provided by the organiser, with a budget alert; stacks deleted at the end of each lab to control cost

facts.label: Assessment
facts.value: A lab validated at the end of each phase, practice exam questions and a final project presented to the group; certificate of completion for participants who complete the labs and the project

facts.label: Outcome
facts.value: Participants can deploy a workload with CloudFormation through a pipeline, monitor it, automate its remediation and patching, test its backup and recovery, report its cost and sit the SOA-C03 exam

phases.name: Monitoring & Automation
phases.focus: CloudWatch, X-Ray, performance tuning, EventBridge, Systems Manager
phases.intro: Participants make a workload observable with CloudWatch metrics, logs, Logs Insights, alarms, dashboards and X-Ray traces, tune it with Compute Optimizer and storage and database settings, then let AWS fix common problems on its own with EventBridge rules and Systems Manager runbooks. Validated lab: a disk-full alarm that triggers an Automation runbook which cleans the instance, with Session Manager replacing SSH.

chapters.title: Monitoring, Logging & Performance
chapters.content: CloudWatch metrics, logs, Logs Insights, alarms, dashboards, X-Ray; performance optimisation with Compute Optimizer, EBS and RDS tuning

chapters.title: Remediation & Automation
chapters.content: EventBridge rules, Systems Manager Automation runbooks, Run Command, Patch Manager, Session Manager

phases.name: Reliability & Deployment
phases.focus: Auto Scaling, load balancing, AWS Backup, DR, CloudFormation, CI/CD, ECS and EKS
phases.intro: Participants keep the workload available through failures and disasters with Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, multi-AZ designs, AWS Backup and recovery strategies chosen against RTO and RPO. They then deploy it as code with CloudFormation, StackSets and drift detection, through a pipeline built with the AWS developer tools, including container workloads on ECS and EKS. Validated lab: a CloudFormation stack deployed by CodePipeline, and a database restored from AWS Backup within the stated recovery objective.

chapters.title: Reliability & Business Continuity
chapters.content: Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, multi-AZ, AWS Backup, RTO and RPO, disaster recovery strategies

chapters.title: Deployment, Provisioning & Automation
chapters.content: CloudFormation, StackSets, drift detection, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline with a Git source, container workloads on ECS and EKS

phases.name: Security, Networking & Exam Preparation
phases.focus: IAM operations, Config, Security Hub, cost controls, VPC troubleshooting, SOA-C03
phases.intro: Participants operate security and compliance controls with IAM, Organizations, Config rules, Security Hub and encryption, keep costs visible with Trusted Advisor, Cost Explorer and Budgets, troubleshoot connectivity with Flow Logs and Reachability Analyzer, then practise exam questions across the SOA-C03 domains. Validated lab: an unreachable instance diagnosed with Reachability Analyzer and fixed, and a non-compliant resource flagged by a Config rule.

chapters.title: Security & Compliance
chapters.content: IAM operations, Organizations, Config rules, Security Hub, encryption, Trusted Advisor, Cost Explorer and Budgets

chapters.title: Networking & Content Delivery
chapters.content: VPC operations, Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, Route 53, CloudFront, connectivity troubleshooting

phases.name: Final Project
phases.focus: A workload operated end to end
phases.intro: Teams of two or three take charge of a provided workload, reusing the phase labs, then present how they run it as they would to an operations manager.

chapters.title: Brief & Deploy
chapters.content: Read the brief, deploy the workload with CloudFormation through CodePipeline, build dashboards and alarms

chapters.title: Automate & Recover
chapters.content: Automated remediation and patching, a backup and disaster recovery test, the cost report and runbook

chapters.title: Demo & Review
chapters.content: Live incident handled by automation, recovery results, teardown; questions and feedback

project.title: Operating a Workload on AWS
project.brief: A workload deployed with CloudFormation through CodePipeline, watched by dashboards and alarms, remediated and patched automatically, recovered in a disaster recovery test, and reported with its monthly cost.
project.stack: AWS: CloudFormation, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CloudWatch, EventBridge, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, Cost Explorer
project.deliverable: Templates and pipeline, dashboards, runbook, DR test results, cost report, live demo
